handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Codex2; previous owner Codex becomes reviewer.

Review commit 815d39948: bi-temporal as-of replay, correction overlays, deterministic evidence hash, confidence-labelled legacy backfill and orphan queue. Verification: 10 focused tests passed; py_compile and git diff --check passed.

CHANGES REQUESTED on 815d39948: replay output and evidence hash discard historical Persona/model/strategy/policy/binding/risk/broker version fields because ReplayResult exposes only JourneyMaterializer snapshots, whose stage entries contain status/time/revision. Reproduced: otherwise-identical event differing only policy_version p1 vs p2 yields same projections and same SHA-256. Preserve deterministic versioned event/timeline data in replay output and hash, including correction-overlay before/after truth; add tests proving version-only changes alter evidence and pre/post correction outputs expose p1 then p2. Verification: existing focused suite 10 passed, but the direct version-difference repro prints same_hash=True and same_projections=True.

Reviewer changes addressed in d19874b6e: replay exposes deterministic full-event timeline, hashes version lineage, and proves policy-only differences plus correction p1-to-p2 truth; focused suite 11 passed.

APPROVED: commits 815d39948 and d19874b6e satisfy deterministic bi-temporal replay, correction overlays, version-lineage hashing, confidence-labelled legacy backfill, orphan/conflict evidence, and dependency composition. Reviewer reran focused suite: 11 passed; py_compile and git diff --check passed.
